categories.name: Highbush blueberry cultivars for Ontario
categories.description: Ontario lists these highbush blueberry cultivars from earliest to latest for home gardens and small-scale production

categories.name: Half-high blueberry cultivars for Ontario
categories.description: Ontario names these half-high blueberries after explaining that colder regions of Ontario may be better suited to lowbush or half-high blueberries than highbush blueberries

rows.name: Northblue
rows.description: Ontario describes Northblue as a vigorous half-high blueberry that reaches 50-75 cm and produces dark blue, large, firm berries

rows.name: St. Cloud
rows.description: Ontario describes St. Cloud as a large half-high blueberry, 100-120 cm, with an upright growth habit and medium-blue, large, slightly flattened fruit

rows.name: Northcountry
rows.description: Ontario describes Northcountry as a smaller half-high blueberry, 45-60 cm, that produces sweet, mild, sky-blue blueberries
